title: Coordinates at free literal positions
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $T$ be a conjunction of literals on $n$ coordinates with no coordinate appearing more than once, and assign to each coordinate one of the restrictions free, fixed at $+1$, or fixed at $-1$. Every coordinate belonging to a literal whose position in $T$ has the free restriction also has the free restriction.
hypotheses_covered: A term whose literal coordinates are pairwise distinct
A restriction assignment from the coordinates to free, fixed at $+1$, or fixed at $-1$
